reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: MLIPs are known to capture many-body interactions better than EAM, and training on diverse liquid configurations directly addresses the phase-space overlap problem, though the claimed 30–50% improvement is speculative without evidence.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with specific metrics and a falsification criterion (less than ~20% improvement), but it lacks details on how phase-space overlap will be quantified and assumes availability of high-quality ab initio training data.
reasons.usefulness: This hypothesis directly tackles a known limitation of TOR-TILD and proposes a concrete, modern solution that would be highly valuable to researchers in the field if validated.
